angleGroups.centralQuestion: Why does this building appear to be built in visibly distinct sections instead of as one uniform structure?
angleGroups.perspectiveShift: The building's mismatched massing -- a 4-story east section, an 11-story main section, a 5-story set-back attic level, and a 7-story tower -- is physical evidence of its original construction in three stages between 1912 and 1932, when it was built for and known as the New York Times Building.
